I15-A (builder A): the prereg toy fixture (f827be4) predates the audit fix F-M2-26 (2940a10, merged after the prereg), under which an M2+ model (holon.gen.machine.Machine(m2plus=True); every milestone after M1, the test milestone T15 included) takes its permissions from the permission guards and raises a label/guard disagreement when actions with the same guard key carry different labels. The toy's commit, finalize, challenge and send (label anyone) and wait (label environment) all lack a caller input and a permission guard, so they form one guard class with two labels: neither `holon run --milestone T15` nor the T15 instrumented model could be built at all (FactsError: principal classes). The one change: wait's principal label environment -> anyone, so the class has one name. No guard, input, effect, span, reason or state changes, so no site, hit, obstruction, law id or expected outcome of TestToyDerivation / TestToyOutcomes moves (labels name a class only; no search policy reads them). Question for the human: the same pattern breaks I13's tests_m2/fixtures/sorts/time_plus_time.json and I14's tests_m2/fixtures/evidence/machine/toy_machine.json under F-M2-26; whether the rule should accept anyone and environment labels on caller-less actions is the lead's call (holon/diagram/principals.py is unchanged here).
